# Hospitalsenhed Midt

Hospitalsenhed Midt is a Danish hospital unit that provides biological disease-modifying therapy (BMSL) for inflammatory bowel disease. As of the period October 2023 to September 2024, the unit treated 662 patients in BMSL therapy, with the patient population split between two primary diagnoses: 442 patients (67%) with Crohn's disease and 219 patients (33%) with ulcerative colitis [^src1].

The unit's patient cohort reflects broader patterns documented in the DANIBD registry, a comprehensive Danish register tracking treatment and outcomes for inflammatory bowel disease across hospital centers nationwide. The data for Hospitalsenhed Midt is embedded within the registry's detailed documentation of biological therapy use, surgical interventions, and comorbid conditions such as primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) among both pediatric and adult patients [^src1].
